name: Tim Rusk
tagline: Top rated Criminal Defense attorney in Tacoma, Washington
side_practice_areas: Criminal Defense, DUI-DWI, White Collar Crimes
about: Tim Rusk is a distinguished attorney born and raised in Tacoma, Washington, where he now leads Tim Rusk Attorneys with a robust commitment to justice and personalized client care. He represents clients across a broad range of practice areas, skillfully handling cases from criminal defense to personal injury law, always placing the client’s needs and best interests first.

In criminal defense , Mr. Rusk expertly navigates complex charges including assault, domestic violence, DUI , drug offenses, theft, sex crimes, and more. Additionally, he assists with criminal expungements, felonies, juvenile crimes, misdemeanors, probation violations, protection orders, violent crimes, weapons crimes, and federal charges. His deep knowledge of Washington’s legal system, combined with aggressive and creative advocacy, ensures his clients' rights are fiercely protected, often securing favorable outcomes even in challenging cases other attorneys might avoid.

In personal injury law , Mr. Rusk provides compassionate yet determined representation for victims of accidents. With particular expertise in motor vehicle accidents—including car, truck, and motorcycle collisions—he also had success in negligent repair cases. As an avid motorcyclist himself, Mr. Rusk brings personal passion and specialized insight to every motorcycle accident case he handles.

A proud Tacoma native, Mr. Rusk graduated from the Carson College of Business at Washington State University (WSU) before earning his law degree from Seattle University School of Law. Licensed since 2015, he is renowned for his approachable, empathetic style and attention to detail.

Beyond expert legal advice, Mr. Rusk offers his clients reassurance and genuine support during life's toughest moments. His outstanding courtroom skills have been widely recognized, notably receiving the Excellent Trial Advocacy Award from the King County Department of Public Defense and being named a Super Lawyers Rising Star, a prestigious honor awarded to only 2.5% of eligible attorneys. He has represented thousands of satisfied clients, many of whom have expressed their appreciation through stellar online reviews .

When you choose Tim Rusk Attorneys, you gain more than just a legal representative—you gain a dedicated advocate personally invested in your future. Contact Tim today for a free, confidential consultation and discover firsthand why he is so highly recommended by clients throughout Western Washington.
